official_sources.title: GDALRasterBand exact min/max location semantics
official_sources.finding: ComputeRasterMinMaxLocation ignores nodata and masked pixels; when the same minimum or maximum occurs at several locations, GDAL does not specify which location is returned.
official_sources.limitation: Therefore a complete tie-set and deterministic representative policy must be project-defined rather than attributed to GDAL.

official_sources.title: GDAL Raster API tutorial RasterIO
official_sources.finding: RasterIO supports windowing, datatype conversion and up/down sampling; exact native-cell replay must pin a one-cell native window and avoid implicit resampling/conversion ambiguity.
official_sources.limitation: API capability alone does not identify target cells.

official_sources.title: gdal raster info
official_sources.finding: Full --stats uses all pixels while --approx-stats may use overviews or a subset; raster info also reports datatype, block size, nodata, unit and checksum.
official_sources.limitation: Approximate or cached statistics are not accepted as exact terminal extrema.

official_sources.title: gdal raster pixel-info
official_sources.finding: pixel-info reports converted column/line, raw and unscaled band values and VRT contributing files, supporting an independent terminal cell ledger.
official_sources.limitation: Native terminal use requires overview/interpolation choices to be pinned.

official_sources.title: GDAL RFC 15 Band Masks
official_sources.finding: GDAL masks distinguish all-valid, per-dataset, alpha and nodata-derived validity; zero mask is invalid and nonzero is valid for processing.
official_sources.limitation: Mask source/flags must be captured from the actual target band.

official_sources.title: GTiff GeoTIFF driver
official_sources.finding: GeoTIFF can use internal/external masks, PAM nodata, sparse implicit blocks and configurable georeferencing-source priority, all of which affect reproducible native-cell interpretation.
official_sources.limitation: Actual driver/open configuration and sidecars must be frozen.

official_sources.title: GDAL VRT format
official_sources.finding: VRT sources can remap nodata and derive values from masks, so contributing-file and source-expression provenance must be retained before accepting a VRT value as terminal evidence.
official_sources.limitation: A VRT value can be derived rather than a literal source-cell value.

official_sources.title: gdal_translate
official_sources.finding: gdal_translate can resample, rescale, unscale, change datatype and override metadata; strict mode can reject lossy conversions.
official_sources.limitation: Translated outputs are derived and cannot silently replace immutable native evidence.

official_sources.title: gdal raster unscale
official_sources.finding: Unscaled value equals raw value times scale plus offset, and output datatype may change; terminal evidence should retain raw value, scale, offset and decoded value together.
official_sources.limitation: Unit/datum correctness remains a separate requirement.

official_sources.title: gdal raster set-type
official_sources.finding: Changing raster datatype may truncate or round values when the output type is smaller, so terminal extrema must precede any lossy type conversion.
official_sources.limitation: Exact conversion impact depends on actual source/output datatypes.

official_sources.title: gdal raster calc
official_sources.finding: Raster calc is pixel-wise derived output and can disable CRS/extent checks; built-in min/max are calculation operations rather than proof of native-source identity.
official_sources.limitation: Useful as independent QA only after input alignment is proven.

official_sources.title: gdal_calc
official_sources.finding: gdal_calc supports NumPy min/max but does not check projections unless projection checking is requested; datatype arithmetic can also affect results.
official_sources.limitation: Calculator extrema are not canonical without explicit alignment and datatype controls.

official_sources.title: gdal2xyz
official_sources.finding: gdal2xyz can export raster values while selecting bands, source windows and nodata handling, providing another independent full-resolution enumeration route.
official_sources.limitation: Sampling/skip options must be disabled or pinned for exhaustive replay.

official_sources.title: gdal raster mosaic
official_sources.finding: Overlapping mosaic inputs use explicit pixel functions or input-list priority, with nodata behavior affecting which source supplies a cell.
official_sources.limitation: Mosaic-derived extrema require source-contributor provenance and are not automatically native single-asset extrema.

official_sources.title: gdal raster reproject
official_sources.finding: Reprojection derives output cells using resampling, may use existing overviews during downsampling and can apply vertical correction when a vertical datum grid is present.
official_sources.limitation: Reprojected values cannot be conflated with source-native cell extrema.

official_sources.title: gdal raster fill-nodata
official_sources.finding: fill-nodata interpolates invalid regions and can smooth results, explicitly creating synthetic values that must be excluded from native extrema evidence.
official_sources.limitation: Derived filled rasters may still be useful for visualization but not terminal sampling.

official_sources.title: gdal raster resize
official_sources.finding: Resize changes raster dimensions using a selectable resampling method while preserving georeferenced extent; output cells are derived.
official_sources.limitation: Resized cells are rejected as native terminal cells.

official_sources.title: gdal raster zonal-stats
official_sources.finding: Zonal stats exposes min/max and min/max cell-center coordinates and supports default, all-touched or fractional polygon pixel inclusion methods.
official_sources.limitation: It is an independent QA path; project terminal membership and tie-set rules remain explicit and separate.

official_sources.title: gdal raster neighbors
official_sources.finding: Neighbors computes focal statistics from surrounding cells and has explicit edge/nodata behavior, so its output is derived and must not enter native extrema selection.
official_sources.limitation: Not a native sampling path.

official_sources.title: gdal raster edit
official_sources.finding: Raster edit can mutate CRS, bounds, nodata, scale, offset and stored full or approximate statistics, demonstrating why cached metadata extrema cannot be trusted without recomputation.
official_sources.limitation: Actual source mutation must be detected by immutable digest/readback.

official_sources.title: GDAL configuration options
official_sources.finding: GDAL thread count and raster block cache are runtime configuration; replay should record them even when exact results are expected to be invariant.
official_sources.limitation: Performance settings alone do not establish correctness.

official_sources.title: gdal raster overview refresh
official_sources.finding: Overview refresh mutates derived overview levels using explicit resampling and may refresh only regions; terminal exact scans must remain bound to full-resolution base data.
official_sources.limitation: Overviews are QA/performance artifacts, not terminal native evidence.
